args.code: (() => { const sidebar = document.querySelector('.sidebar') || document.querySelector('aside') || document.querySelector('[class*=side]'); if (!sidebar) return 'no sidebar'; const items = sidebar.querySelectorAll('*'); let result = []; for (let el of items) { const text = el.textContent.trim(); if (text && text.length < 20 && text.length > 0) { result.push({tag: el.tagName, class: el.className, text: text}); } } return JSON.stringify(result.slice(0, 20)); })()
